sentences.text:
Smt. Bandana Samanta & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal on
12 June, 2023
Author: Bibek Chaudhuri

Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri
12.06.2023
 Sl. No.02
 Mithun
 Ct.No.42. Wpa 15974 of 1998
 Smt. Bandana Samanta & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal
 Mr. Golam Mastafa, Adv.
 Mr. Tarasankar Samanta, Adv.
 ...for the petitioners.

Mr. Soumitra Bandopadhyay, Adv.
 Mr. Prasanta Behari Mahata, Adv.
 ...for the State.

Grievance of the petitioners is that the petitioners
 were the erstwhile owners of 30 decimal of land by
 purchase in plot No.65 within Mouza Lauhajung, Police
 Station Mahisadal at present Nandakumar in the
 District of East Midnapore.
In connection with Act II L.A. Case No.R & A 137  of 1980-81, a portion of said land measuring about 22  decimal was acquired by initiating a proceeding by the  L.A. Collector of undivided Midnapore.

It is the grievance of the petitioner that though 22  decimal of land was acquisitioned, the respondent authority has been using entire 30 decimal of land without paying any compensation thereof.

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned Advocate for the respondent that the entire record of L.A. Case No. R & A 137 of 1980-81 is lying in the custody of the L.A. Collector, Paschim Midnapore.

entities.text: L.A. Case No. R & A 137 of 1980
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Without the record of R & A 137 of 1980-81, the instant writ petition cannot be effectively disposed of.

Under such circumstances, the petitioners are at liberty to implead the L.A. Collector, Paschim Midnapore and Special Land Acquisition Officer, Paschim Midnapore as party respondents in the instant writ petition within a fortnight by filing an appropriate application.
The instant writ petition be listed under the heading "Application" after a fortnight.

(Bibek Chaudhuri, J.)
